regulator: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

source_document.title: Insurance Ombudsman (Amendment) Rules, 2023
source_document.issuer: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
source_document.source_note: Amendment notification to the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.

applies_to: Insurers subject to the Insurance Ombudsman Rules
applicability.application_note: Read these amendments together with the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, including any subsequent amendments.

amendments.description: The maximum compensation limit under Rule 17(3) was increased from INR 30 lakh to INR 50 lakh.
amendments.legal_effect: The Ombudsman compensation ceiling is increased to INR 50 lakh, subject to the other requirements and limitations in Rule 17(3).
applicability_conditions: The complaint is maintainable under the Insurance Ombudsman Rules.
The matter falls within the Ombudsman's jurisdiction.
The compensation sought and awarded must satisfy the applicable requirements of Rule 17(3).
exceptions_or_limits: The maximum limit is not an automatic entitlement to INR 50 lakh.
The amount awarded remains subject to the applicable Rule 17(3) conditions and limitations.
evidence_to_check: Complaint and correspondence with the insurer
amendments.ai_guidance: Do not automatically recommend INR 50 lakh compensation. Assess the actual direct loss, the relief requested, the Ombudsman's jurisdiction and all applicable Rule 17(3) conditions.

amendment_history.integration_instruction: Apply this amendment to the corresponding provision of the 2017 Rules. Do not replace the entire parent regulation with this amendment file.

ai_safety_instructions: Load this amendment together with the parent Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.
Check for any subsequent amendment before calculating compensation limits.
Do not treat the maximum compensation limit as the amount automatically payable.
Check the exact scope and conditions of Rule 17(3).
Do not present an amendment summary as verbatim legal text.
Use only verified provisions for definitive legal explanations.
verification_checklist: Verify the notification date against the Gazette.
Check the exact text amending Rule 17(3).
Confirm the previous and updated compensation limits.
Check whether any subsequent amendment changed the compensation limit.
Verify the amendment's effective date and applicability.
dataset_limitations: This file contains a selected amendment summary, not the complete amendment notification.
The legal effect must be read with the parent Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.
The amendment is marked pending verification until checked against the official Gazette notification.
